name: Sporeling Burrow
description: A warm burrow that buds two Sporelings at a time. Cheap bodies that hold ground.

name: Capguard Hall
description: Trains Capguards: sturdy line troops that shred Light swarms.

name: Gill Archer Nest
description: Gill Archers loose spore darts from range. Pierce breaks Medium line troops.

name: Rootbreaker Den
description: Rootbreakers are slow rams that crack buildings and Heartcaps (siege).

name: Puffball Mortar
description: A tower that lobs bursting puffballs. Crush splash; cannot hit units hugging it.

name: Truffle Cellar
description: Grows truffles for gold every income tick. +50% on Rich Loam.

name: Scythecap Grove
description: Scythecaps swing curved blades that cleave through Light swarms (splash).

name: Veilstalker Hollow
description: Veilstalkers hunt in pairs: fast Slayers that deal ×3 damage to Bloomed and Elder units.

name: Tender's Ring
description: A fairy ring that sends out Tenders: support units that heal the most-hurt ally nearby instead of fighting.
